name: codex-dsh-web
description: Drive and verify DSH Web sessions from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to local DSH Web sessions.
interface.longDescription: Create and reuse DSH Web sessions, open the live UI in Codex Desktop, exchange prompts over its local HTTP API, inspect results, and feed Codex verification back into the same session.
defaultPrompt: Open DSH Web in Codex's built-in browser and confirm the local service is reachable.
Open DSH Web in the built-in browser, then use it to implement my task and verify the changes.
Open the existing DSH Web session in the built-in browser and continue the task.
